description: Gasti helps you review and maintain your personal financial records through your connected account. List, record, edit and delete income and expenses; manage account records and categories; record transfers already made between your accounts; and review income and expense reports by currency, account and category. Gasti does not hold funds, initiate payments or exchange currencies. Account numbers or aliases and the last four card digits are optional account metadata. When analytics is enabled, tool calls record the user and OAuth client identifiers, tool name, outcome and duration; transaction inputs and results are not included in those usage events.
